recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy 1950s-themed collage featuring a central couple performing a swing dance move in a diner setting, framed by bold geometric blocks and vibrant orange borders. The aesthetic is kitschy and nostalgic, utilizing saturated colors and layered photographic elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Central dancing couple as the primary focal point
Overlapping tilted geometric rectangles framing the main title
Secondary inset photograph in the bottom right corner
Vibrant orange outer border containing supporting text
coreInvariants: High-saturation orange and yellow color palette
Tilted, non-parallel geometric framing for text
Layered composition with depth created by overlapping elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main dancing couple occupies the center-left and center-right, spanning the horizontal middle of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, blue, vertically-elongated title text set against yellow and blue rectangles at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top title, follow the dancer's arm down to the central action, then move to the inset photo at the bottom right, finally scanning the text in the orange footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and 'busy' to reflect the energy of the music genre.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant orange used for the outer frame and background accents.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and cyan blue used for geometric text blocks.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep reds and blues in the clothing of the subjects.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary colors to evoke a cheerful, energetic mood.

letterConstructionRules: Title uses extremely condensed, tall sans-serif glyphs
Supporting text uses a mix of italicized scripts and clean sans-serifs
Text is often placed on tilted baselines within geometric containers
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated vertical strokes on title characters
Tilted orientation for 'over' text within a separate block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed display sans-serif paired with a casual, handwritten-style script for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the condensed, bold verticality of the main title.
Matches the casual 1950s vibe for secondary headings.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1950s diner interior with people in period clothing. A man in a dark shirt and jeans is swinging a woman in a red top. The scene is saturated and warm. Add a vibrant orange border around the entire image. Place a small inset photo of a male singer in the bottom right corner with a thin yellow border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, vertically-stretched cyan blue text at the top. Place the first and third words over yellow tilted rectangles, and the middle word over a smaller blue tilted rectangle. Add white script text in the top orange border and small yellow/white sans-serif text in the bottom orange border.

verificationChecks: Is the title text vertically elongated?
Are the background blocks for the title tilted?
Is the color palette dominated by orange and yellow?
Is the central action a 50s-style dance move?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the geometric background blocks
Specific 50s diner activity (e.g., drinking milkshakes vs dancing)
Width of the outer orange border
mustRedesign: Specific faces and likenesses of the people
Any specific brand logos on diner equipment
Exact wording of the tracklist and artist names

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between title and image

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text blocks do not obscure the dancers' faces.
Ensure the orange border is consistent in width.
Verify the inset photo feels like a separate 'clipped' element.
Confirm the title font feels tall and condensed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered 1950s photography + Tilted geometric text containers + Saturated orange/yellow palette + Condensed display typography.
